name: Ice cream
summary: An ice-cream cone on Tràng Tiền is the evening walk around Hoàn Kiếm. Vietnam Tourism calls that cone an essential Hanoi habit.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism’s Old Quarter article sets the cone on Tràng Tiền, on the lake walk.
howToEat: Buy a cone and walk the lake in the evening.
where: Tràng Tiền, on the evening walk.
seoDescription: The Hanoi ice-cream cone Vietnam Tourism places on Tràng Tiền, for an evening walk around Hoàn Kiếm.
